metadata.description: Stride task management skills for AI agents

plugins.name: stride
plugins.description: Drive the full Stride kanban task lifecycle from Claude Code: claim, explore, implement, review and complete tasks with automatic lifecycle hooks, and create, enrich and decompose goals and tasks. Release history is in the plugin's CHANGELOG.

plugins.name: stride-security-review
plugins.description: AI-powered security review of code changes via /stride-security-review:security-review: diff or full-repo scans, framework rule packs for web, mobile and CI/CD, SARIF output and severity gating for CI, and a considerations mode that checks a task's security_considerations were mitigated.

plugins.name: stride-ideation
plugins.description: Turn a fuzzy idea into shipped Stride tasks via two slash commands — /ideate drives an interactive, profile-aware question loop that hard-gates seven requirements sections into a committed markdown doc, and /stridify decomposes that doc into Stride goals and tasks via the batch API.

plugins.name: stride-lite
plugins.description: Lightweight companion to Stride that writes Stride-shaped goal and task markdown documents to disk from a prompt and an optional requirements directory. No API calls, no kanban setup, no auth files.

plugins.name: launchdarkly
plugins.description: Generate correct, testable and removable LaunchDarkly feature-flag code for the Java server SDK and the TypeScript SDKs (Node server, browser, React), with scaffolding and flag-removal commands and an anti-pattern review agent.

plugins.name: stride-exploratory-testing
plugins.description: Charter-based exploratory testing in Claude Code: plan charters, run budgeted sessions against a running app under an absolute safety boundary, judge results with oracles, and capture findings as a session sheet and debrief.
